name: akshara
description: Akshara (अक्षर) — Interactive Nepali Devanagari literacy engine with parametric Pati slate stroke tracing, Shirorekha topological validation, Barakhari Matra fusion, and SOV sentence construction.
author: Ashok Adhikari

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@akshara/data && npm run build --workspace=@akshara/core && npm run build --workspace=@akshara/cli && npm run build --workspace=@akshara/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@akshara/data && npm run typecheck --workspace=@akshara/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@akshara/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@akshara/web
